en.answer: Even if a Ritual Monster that used multiple copies of <<8473>> for its Ritual Summon destroys a monster by battle, you will only draw a single card.
en.question: I control a Ritual Monster that was Ritual Summoned using multiple copies of <<8473>>. If this Ritual Monster destroys a monster by battle, how many cards do I draw?
en.title: If a Ritual Monster was Summoned using multiple <<8473>>, how many cards do I draw if it battles?
